outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map paired with western blot images (IP efficiency blots), not a plot of averaged data. No bar/quantification plot requiring individual points is present here.

Bar charts show % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance per antibody, apparently derived from single densitometry quantifications per antibody (no replicate/error-bar information given, unlike panel E which explicitly states n=4, mean ± SD). Since these do not represent an average across replicates, individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a bar chart showing mean ± SD (n = 4) for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 abundances, and individual data points (circles for each of the 4 replicates) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted molecular structure, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel G consists of scatterplots, where each point is itself an individual data point (a protein), so the exemption for scatterplots applies.
Panel H is a scatterplot showing individual IP-MS experiments as points; scatterplots are exempt from the requirement since the points themselves are the individual data.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each marker represents an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel J consists of PCA scatterplots (per tissue) where each marker represents an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
